# Lab 4.19: Manage Users & Groups Programmatically

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a group, add members and list memberships from Cloud Shell using the Cloud Identity Groups API through gcloud.

## Steps

1. **Enable the API and find your customer ID.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable cloudidentity.googleapis.com
gcloud organizations list</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Note the **DIRECTORY_CUSTOMER_ID** column, for example `C0abc123`.

2. **Create a security group.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud identity groups create gcp-auditors@YOUR_DOMAIN \
  --organization=YOUR_DOMAIN \
  --display-name="GCP Auditors" \
  --labels="cloudidentity.googleapis.com/groups.discussion_forum,cloudidentity.googleapis.com/groups.security"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Add a member.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud identity groups memberships add \
  --group-email=gcp-auditors@YOUR_DOMAIN \
  --member-email=sam@YOUR_DOMAIN</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **List members and look up a user's groups.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud identity groups memberships list --group-email=gcp-auditors@YOUR_DOMAIN

gcloud identity groups memberships search-transitive-groups \
  --member-email=sam@YOUR_DOMAIN \
  --labels="cloudidentity.googleapis.com/groups.discussion_forum"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Grant the group a role.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID \
  --member=group:gcp-auditors@YOUR_DOMAIN \
  --role=roles/iam.securityReviewer</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID \
  --member=group:gcp-auditors@YOUR_DOMAIN \
  --role=roles/iam.securityReviewer
gcloud identity groups delete gcp-auditors@YOUR_DOMAIN</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Group creation | Works from gcloud, no Admin console needed |
| Security label | Set at creation with `--labels` |
| Transitive search | Shows nested group membership |
| Automation | Same calls can run in scripts and pipelines |
